question: Suppose ΔABC be a right angled triangle where ∠A = 90° and AD ⊥ BC. If area (ΔABC) = 80 cm² and BC = 16 cm, then the length of AD is :
solution:
Given:

ΔABC is a right-angled triangle where ∠A = 90° and AD ⊥ BC. 

Area (ΔABC) = 80 cm2 and BC = 16 cm.

Concept used:

Area of a triangle = 1/2 × Base × Height

Calculation:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/444279d195aa7b9a12bd9ed0fffc8b6edfe93ce4c701a75f7688e27fbe52c72c.png] 

Considering ΔABC, BC = base of ΔABC and AD = Height of ΔABC.

​According to the question,

1/2 × AD × BC = area (ΔABC)

⇒ 1/2 × AD × 16 = 80

⇒ AD = 10

∴ The measure of AD is 10 cm.
